hits.about: The Beach Residences is an elite project from The Range Developments company. The residential complex is located on the island of Al Marjan Island in Ras Al Khaiman, the building consists of 17 floors. The residence combines modern luxury with the natural beauty of the serene coast and offers breathtaking views of the sea and pristine beaches. Studios and spacious apartments with 1,2 and 3 bedrooms are available for sale, as well as the complex includes townhouses with private pools and gardens. The interiors are designed in a modern style using delicate shades, which creates a cozy atmosphere. The panoramic windows are filled with sunlight, which visually expands the space and offers spectacular views of the Persian Gulf.Premium world-class amenities are provided for residents: a beach, swimming pools with a relaxation area, two cinema halls, a barbecue area, a tennis court, a playground, a children's pool, a yoga studio, restaurants and bars by the pool.The Beach Residences has an advantageous location, which allows residents to easily reach different areas of the emirate. There are many supermarkets, educational institutions and other social infrastructure facilities within a 15—minute drive from the residences – AlJazeera Supermarket, Al Maya Supermarket, Al Ghadeer Kindergarten, 9011, Little Treasures Nursery, RAK Academy - British School Al Hamra – BSH. Ras Al Khaimah International Airport is just 30 minutes away.
hits.title: The Beach Residences
